sites.name: Kitchen Butterfly
sites.note: Long-running blog by Nigerian food writer and historian Ozoz Sokoh, with Nigerian and New Nigerian recipes.

sites.name: Sisi Yemmie
sites.note: Nigerian home cooking recipes and meal plans, paired with the SisiYemmieTV YouTube channel.

cookbooks.title: My Everyday Lagos: Nigerian Cooking at Home and in the Diaspora
cookbooks.author: Yewande Komolafe
cookbooks.note: Nigerian home cooking adapted for kitchens abroad by a New York Times Cooking contributor.

cookbooks.title: Chop Chop: Cooking the Food of Nigeria
cookbooks.author: Ozoz Sokoh
cookbooks.note: Survey of Nigerian dishes and ingredients from the writer behind Kitchen Butterfly.

sites.note: Recipes from Ethiopian-born caterer and cooking instructor Eleni Woldeyes near Portland; also promotes her spice and sauce shop.

cookbooks.title: Ethiopia: Recipes and Traditions from the Horn of Africa

cookbooks.title: Casablanca: My Moroccan Food

sites.name: TASTE

cookbooks.title: Seychelles Creole Cuisine

sites.name: Ndudu by Fafa (Togolese posts)
